meta.name: Dekhechhi Tomake Shrabone
meta.description:
Rudra, the son of a powerful promoter tries to win over Ira's heart. Ira, the widow of Ayan has shut all doors post Ayan's death. Would Rudra's unfathomable love conquer the Ira and give her life a new beginning?

Returning Series · First aired 27 Sept 2024 · India · Language: Bengali · 145 min
Studio: Surinder Films

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

On your server — Audio: Bengali

videos.title: The First Rain | Ep 1
videos.overview: With the season’s first rain Rudra meets Ira and falls in love. But he didn’t know that her past will take him to the dangerous road of life and death. The love comes in the way of a business deal where Rudra’s father was planning to capture Ira’s house for his new building project.

videos.title: The First Love | Ep 2
videos.overview: Ira is still living in her past life with her first love. She confronts Rudra as an arrogant goon and declares her hatred for him. Meanwhile Rudra’s father is up to snatching away Ira’s home for his own business need. Ira comes in between losing her home as well as losing her life.

videos.title: The Confession | Ep 3
videos.overview: Rudra gathers up all his courage & confesses his love to Ira & her In Laws. He declares to keep her happy & safe. Ira finally decides to end this game as it was going out of her hand. Rudra asks his mother if it is ok to fall in love with a widow.

videos.title: The Deal | Ep 4
videos.overview: Ira’s Father in law makes a deal to give away the land and house to the promoters for the safety of Ira. Rudra makes a deal to return the property to Ira sacrificing his love and Ira makes a deal that Rudra should not come in her way, else she will end her own life to end the shameful drama.

videos.title: The Bullet | Ep 5
videos.overview: Rudra’s mother tries to talk to Ira to make her understand the true love her son is nurturing in his heart for her but Ira tells her she is happy with her past life. Ira’s family is busy in shifting as they will be leaving the house & Rudra’s father finds a suitable match for Rudra. But things take a new turn as Rudra is hit by a bullet aimed for Ira.

videos.title: The Last Call | Ep 6
videos.overview: Rudra struggles on death bed and Ira’s In laws makes her question her believes. They make her understand that love can happen twice & its not a taboo to forget her past & embrace a new life. Ira runs to the hospital to accept Rudra’s love while Rudra was taking his last breath.
